specs.note: Specifications transcribed from the MCX contract-specification PDFs linked on each product page (mcxindia.com/products/...), read 2026-11-14. Margins are exchange minimums; brokers charge more, and MCX changes them by circular.

method: US ETF options are a sentiment and skew proxy for the MCX contract, not its order book. IVs are backed out from mid prices (Black-Scholes on the put-call-parity forward, volpro.Surface); gamma uses volpro.bs_gamma. Event-day move = absolute close-to-close change on the first session on or after the event, against sessions with no tracked event over the same span.
